tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: true-black
tokens.usage: Professional depth, reduces screen glare. Used as background on `body`; text on `.symbol-icon`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: dark-gray
tokens.usage: Content separation without harsh contrast. Used as background on `.header`, `.stat-card`, `.content-card`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.index-name`, `.stat-label`, `.list-item-name`. 3.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: neon-green
tokens.usage: Positive movements, gains, active states. Used as background on `.status-indicator`, `.status-dot`; text on `.positive`, `.card-action:hover`, `.status-badge.filled`. 14.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: neon-blue
tokens.usage: Neutral information, interactive elements. Used as text on `.logo`, `.nav-link.active`, `.card-action`; background on `.nav-link.active::after`. 11.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: alert-red
tokens.usage: Losses, warnings, critical alerts. Used as text on `.negative`, `.status-badge.cancelled`. 5.8:1 on `page-bg`.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata — as `div.news-meta` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels — as `button.filter-button` on the reference page. The reference page leaves this element on the browser default face; set it in the body family.
